_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html): one per community district (and each big park or airport the City maps as its own area). Stops and changes to the hubs are counted along each service's own pattern (raw/subway_patterns.json, written by build.py from the MTA GTFS), so an express skips what it skips. factsheet.css styles the line bullets and bus badges in the MTA's colours.

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each of New York City’s 59 community districts: subway, buses, highways, drive times, parks, libraries and Citi Bike. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
